text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Heeey~! Help meee~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I can't come up with any ideas for my next stream!
Got any suggestions~?
"An art stream" immediately came to mind, but I should explore if there are better options. In this case—
choice_data_list: At times like this, why not ask for everyone's help?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so! Today, we're doing a stream
to "Decide What to Do on the Next Stream"!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Anything goes! Fire away with your opinions—
Oh, that was fast! Thanks for all the comments, everyone~♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... "I wanna see a cooking stream again!"
"Please stream on race day too!
I want to cheer Love-chan on in the comments!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you going to stream fighting games?"
...Mhm, mhm, I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they're all pretty different~.
I can't decide which one to pick.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's turn this into a poll, too!
Alright everyone, please cast your votes~♡
choice_data_list: I vote for a race cheer livestream!
A fighting game stream is the only choice!
A fighting game stream is definitely the only choice!
I wanna watch Loves' cooking stream!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's turn this into a poll, too!
Alright everyone, please cast your votes~♡
choice_data_list: I vote for a race cheer livestream!
A fighting game stream is the only choice!
A fighting game stream is definitely the only choice!
I wanna watch Loves' cooking stream!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, it's officially decided to be a race watch-along stream!
Yay, clap clap clap~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Can't wait!"... Right~! I can't wait either!
I wonder what kind of stream it'll be?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Passionate-sensei's comment is on fire?
Ah, is this it...?

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're always giving so much to me,
I'll make sure to deliver all my support on the stream!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Thank you.
What a wonderful comment♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still... hmm.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's not true that you're only ever receiving, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone always tells you, don't they?
—'You gave me strength,' and 'Thank you.'"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's actually the opposite. Getting those
reports is what's giving *me* strength.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So, business as usual.
I'm counting on your cheers, okay?♡

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Of course!" "Wooooo!"
"My hype is through the roof!!"
"Let's cheeeeer her on!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha♡ Hey, everyone~?
Just act like usual! Just like usual, I say~!

And so, it was decided that Loves Only You
would host a livestream on race day.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's have a match right away, everyone!
The first challenger is... "Soft-Boiled Egg"-san!

"Hang in there, Soft-Boiled Egg!" "You got this!"
Warm cheers were sent to the community member challenging her
at fighting games. How would it turn out—?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! We won! I didn't know what to do
when that combo hit us, honestly~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Good try, Soft-Boiled Egg!" "Just a bad matchup!"
...Wait, aren't there barely any comments actually praising me?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, who's up next~!
Oh! 'Former Pro Gamer'-san!

"A former pro?!" "We've got this in the bag, wahaha!"
The chat exploded with anticipation that this time would be the one! And the result was—!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright! I won~!

The chat filled up with those words.
It seemed her skill was simply not something
ordinary commu-members could compete with—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hmm~? What's the matter, everyone~? Your fave just won the race, so let's hear some cheers~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, next!
Who wants to take me on~?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: "I'm good." "Me too." "Oh, gotta hang out the laundry." "By the way, isn't the weather nice today?" "Totally, it's great!" "How about you, Kakehashi-san?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, wait—!? You're dodging the subject!
Play with me~! C'mon~~!!
And so, her fighting game stream was even more hype than usual.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! Amazing!
It's not too sweet, I totally love it!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just like a raspberry pie from a bakery"... Heheh♡
You really know how to flatter a girl!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Alright! Next, let's go even more—... .........
choice_data_list: "Hmm? Why did you suddenly go quiet? What's wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hey. So I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we do a cooking stream...
I'm always the only one doing the cooking, aren't I?

The comment section fills with question marks.
"Well, yeah, this is a cooking stream, right?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone else is just watching without joining in?
That's so not fair~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so! Next time, we're having a
"Cooking Video Watch Party" with the videos everyone took!

The chat lit up with "Whaaaat!?" and "That was so sudden!"
I couldn't help but chuckle as I found myself typing out a comment too—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?!
I want to enjoy the stream *together* with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while, I want everyone to show me
their love for cooking! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The next video is from "Pencil," right?
The creator is... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan Cookies", it says!
What's up with that, it's just too lovelyyy♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wah!!! So cute~~!! It looks just like me!
It's way too cute to eat, no way~!
And so, her cooking stream turned out to be livelier than ever.
